ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the interior surface area, while low-intensity (black) pixels are concentrated along the peripheral trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid white pigmentation across the central and medial lobes; thick, continuous black banding along the entire trailing edge; irregular black mottling and dense cluster patches at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 40 degrees, extending approximately 25% into the vertical height of the fluke centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels across the entire trailing boundary; most pronounced jaggedness occurs at the distal lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch to the tips, exhibiting a slightly more pronounced curvature on the right lobe relative to the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-contrast clusters of circular and irregular light-colored pixel regions (barnacle scars/colonies) situated at the extreme distal tips and the trailing edge near the tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation and resulting surface irregularity at both distal tips; small scattered dark focal spots (mottling) on the lower interior white surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black spot located on the interior white field of the right lobe, approximately midway between the notch and the tip.
